# The us-equities feed

US equities from SEC EDGAR (companies, filings, financials, index membership).

The companies of the Dow 30, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq-100 and the Russell 2000 (index membership from SPY, DIA, QQQ and IWM N-PORT holdings) and major US, Canadian and UK banks: SEC EDGAR companies, SIC sectors, recent filings and ten years of annual XBRL financials, LEIs from GLEIF, headquarters and websites from Wikidata.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF, Wikidata (https://www.sec.gov/edgar) |
| Licence | [Public domain (U.S. Government work); Wikidata and GLEIF CC0](https://www.sec.gov/privacy#dissemination): redistributable |
| Attribution | Source: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (EDGAR); Wikidata (CC0); GLEIF (CC0) |
| Notes | SEC fair access policy (a descriptive User-Agent with a contact, at most 10 requests a second) |
| Lake | `capitalmarket` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 07:00 (local time) |
| Pull | `us_equities.UsEquitiesFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/us_equities.py); 0.13 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run us-equities --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run us-equities                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/, load into capitalmarket
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status us-equities             # its last runs
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run us-equities --snapshot     # refresh the committed demo snapshot instead
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### us-company

Pack `us-equities`, kind `us-company` (US company), table `us-company`, key `TICKER`; files `data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/us-company.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A listed company: CIK, ticker, LEI, SIC, headquarters.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TICKER` | id | required | The company's primary ticker (SEC company tickers file): the record's key. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The company's name: its Wikidata label, else the SEC name in title case. |
| `SEC_NAME` | text | required | The company's name as SEC EDGAR registers it (submissions name). |
| `CIK` | text | required | The SEC Central Index Key, ten digits with leading zeros (text, never a number). |
| `OTHER_TICKERS` | text | optional | The company's other tickers on EDGAR (preferred shares, other classes), comma separated; empty when none. |
| `EXCHANGE` | text | required | The exchanges EDGAR lists the company's securities on, comma separated (Nasdaq, NYSE ...). |
| `LISTING` | text | required | The listing market from the Nasdaq Trader symbol directory (for example Nasdaq Global Select Market). |
| `SIC` | text | required | The SEC Standard Industrial Classification code (four digits, text). |
| `SIC_DESCRIPTION` | text | required | The company's SIC industry in words, as EDGAR gives it (sicDescription). |
| `DIVISION` | text | required | The letter of the SIC division the code falls in (A to J); empty when unclassified. |
| `SECTOR` | text | required | The name of the SIC division (Manufacturing, Finance, Insurance and Real Estate ...), or Unclassified. |
| `STATE_OF_INCORPORATION` | text | optional | The state (or country) code of incorporation, as EDGAR gives it. |
| `FISCAL_YEAR_END` | text | optional | The fiscal year end as MM-DD (EDGAR fiscalYearEnd). |
| `FILER_CATEGORY` | text | optional | The SEC filer category (Large accelerated filer, Non-accelerated filer ...). |
| `HEADQUARTERS` | text | optional | The headquarters city, from Wikidata. |
| `BUSINESS_ADDRESS` | text | optional | The business address's city and state or country code, from EDGAR. |
| `FOUNDED` | date | optional | The date the company was founded (YYYY-MM-DD), from Wikidata. |
| `WEBSITE` | text | optional | The company's website: Wikidata's, else EDGAR's. |
| `PHONE` | text | required | The business phone number, from EDGAR. |
| `LEI` | text | optional | The company's Legal Entity Identifier (20 characters), from Wikidata or matched in GLEIF by legal name; empty when none was found. |
| `LEI_LEGAL_NAME` | text | optional | The legal name GLEIF registers for the LEI. |
| `LEI_STATUS` | text | optional | The LEI's registration status in GLEIF (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, DUPLICATE ...). |
| `LEI_SOURCE` | text | optional | How the LEI was found: from Wikidata (checked in GLEIF), matched in GLEIF by legal name, or Wikidata only. |
| `INDEXES` | record list | required | The indices and lists the company is in, one element each: INDEX (DJIA, NDX, SP500, BANKS-US …), NAME and SINCE; empty when it is in none. |
| `INDEX_TEXT` | text | optional | The names of the indexes and lists the company is a member of, comma separated. |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required | The currency the company reports its XBRL financials in (USD for most; a 40-F or 20-F filer may report in CAD, EUR, GBP). |
| `FISCAL_YEAR` | integer | optional | The latest fiscal year with figures: the year of REVENUE, NET_INCOME, ASSETS, LIABILITIES, EQUITY and EPS_DILUTED (an integer). |
| `REVENUE` | amount | optional | Total revenue of FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap Revenues, else RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, else net sales), in CURRENCY. |
| `NET_INCOME` | amount | optional | Net income (loss) attributable to the company for FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap NetIncomeLoss, else ProfitLoss), in CURRENCY; a loss negative. |
| `ASSETS` | integer | optional | Total assets at the latest fiscal year end (us-gaap Assets, else liabilities and equity). |
| `LIABILITIES` | integer | optional | Total liabilities at the latest fiscal year end (us-gaap Liabilities, else liabilities and equity less total equity). |
| `EQUITY` | integer | optional | Stockholders' equity at the end of FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap StockholdersEquity), in CURRENCY; a number, not a link. |
| `EPS_DILUTED` | amount | optional | Diluted earnings per share for FISCAL_YEAR (us-gaap EarningsPerShareDiluted, else basic), in CURRENCY per share. |
| `SHARES_OUTSTANDING` | integer | optional | Common shares outstanding on the cover of the latest annual report (dei EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding). |
| `FINANCIALS` | record list | required | The company's figures for each fiscal year, oldest first (up to ten), one element per year: YEAR, PERIOD_END, REVENUE, NET_INCOME, ASSETS, LIABILITIES, EQUITY and EPS_DILUTED, in CURRENCY. |
| `FACTS` | record list | required | The company's financial facts, one element per concept: FACT (a FACT_ID of the financial-fact kind, <ticker>-<concept>) and LABEL. |
| `FILINGS` | record list | required | The company's latest EDGAR filings, newest first (up to 20), one element each: ACCESSION, FORM, FILED, REPORT_DATE and DESCRIPTION. |
| `INDEX_IDS` | id list | required | The indices and lists the company is in: INDEX codes of the index-membership kind (SP500, NDX, DJIA, BANKS-US …); empty when none. |
| `FACT_IDS` | id list | required | The company's financial facts: FACT_IDs of the financial-fact kind (<ticker>-<concept>, ABT-REVENUE). |
| `FILING_IDS` | id list | required | The company's latest filings: ACCESSION numbers of the filing kind. |
| `LATEST_FILING` | date | required | The filing date of the company's most recent filing (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `SIC_SECTOR` | id | required | The company's SIC industry code (EDGAR sic, four digits as text): the id of the computed sic-sector kind. |
| `PRICE_HISTORY` | id | required | The id of the company's price history (PX-<TICKER>), a kind served live by the prices connector; no data is committed. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (SEC EDGAR, Wikidata, GLEIF, Nasdaq Trader), RETRIEVED_AT (YYYY-MM-DD), LICENCE and URL. |
| `ECONOMY` | id | optional | The company's home economy from its business address: ECON-USA for a US address, ECON-CAN or ECON-GBR for Canada or the UK; an id of the world-economy pack's economy kind; absent otherwise. |
| `MARKET_WATCH` | id | optional | The same company in the news-and-markets pack: an id of its listed-company kind (CO-<ticker>), when it is one of the twenty. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"TICKER": "AAPL", "NAME": "Apple Inc.", "SEC_NAME": "Apple Inc.", "CIK": "0000320193", "OTHER_TICKERS": "C-PN, C-PR", "EXCHANGE": "Nasdaq", "LISTING": "Nasdaq Global Select Market", "SIC": "3571", "SIC_DESCRIPTION": "Electronic Computers", "DIVISION": "D", "SECTOR": "Manufacturing", "STATE_OF_INCORPORATION": "CA", "FISCAL_YEAR_END": "09-26", "FILER_CATEGORY": "Large accelerated filer", "HEADQUARTERS": "Cupertino", "BUSINESS_ADDRESS": "CUPERTINO, CA", "FOUNDED": "1976-04-01", "WEBSITE": "https://apple.com/qa/", "PHONE": "(408) 996-1010", "LEI": "HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394", "LEI_LEGAL_NAME": "Apple Inc.", "LEI_STATUS": "ISSUED", "LEI_SOURCE": "GLEIF, LEI from Wikidata", "INDEX_TEXT": "Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500", "CURRENCY": "USD", "FISCAL_YEAR": 2025, "REVENUE": 416161000000, "NET_INCOME": 112010000000, "ASSETS": 359241000000, "LIABILITIES": 285508000000, "EQUITY": 73733000000, "EPS_DILUTED": 7.46, "SHARES_OUTSTANDING": 14776353000, "LATEST_FILING": "2026-10-22", "SIC_SECTOR": "3571", "PRICE_HISTORY": "PX-AAPL", "ECONOMY": "ECON-USA", "MARKET_WATCH": "CO-AAPL"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/us-company.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).

### index-membership

Pack `us-equities`, kind `index-membership` (Index members), table `index-membership`, key `INDEX`; files `data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/index-membership.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

An index's members (SP500, NDX, DJIA, R2000, bank lists).

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INDEX` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The index or list's name (Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500, Major US banks …). |
| `MEMBERS` | integer | required | How many members ROWS holds. |
| `ROWS` | record list | required | The members, by ticker, one element each with its name, SIC sector and division, exchange, latest revenue and net income in CURRENCY, fiscal year and SINCE. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the membership comes from, one object: SOURCE (the tracking ETF's N-PORT holdings, or a curated list), LICENCE, NOTE and RETRIEVED_AT. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"INDEX": "DJIA", "NAME": "Dow Jones Industrial Average", "MEMBERS": 34}
```

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/index-membership.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).

### filing-feed

Pack `us-equities`, kind `filing-feed` (EDGAR filings browser), table `filing-feed`, key `FEED`; files `data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/filing-feed.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A company's recent filings as one feed.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FEED` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The feed's name: Every form, Annual reports (10-K), Quarterly reports (10-Q), Current reports (8-K), Insider transactions (Form 4) or Proxy statements (DEF 14A). |
| `FORM` | text | optional | The SEC form type the feed shows; empty for the feed of every form (ALL). |
| `FILINGS` | integer | required | How many filings ROWS holds (the latest filings, at most 300). |
| `COMPANIES` | integer | required | How many different companies filed the filings in ROWS. |
| `LATEST` | date | required | The filing date of the newest filing in ROWS, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `EARLIEST` | date | required | The filing date of the oldest filing in ROWS, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `ROWS` | record list | required | The feed's filings, newest first, one element each: ACCESSION, FILED, COMPANY, COMPANY_NAME, FORM and DESCRIPTION. |
| `BY` | record list | required | The filings counted by form (the ALL feed) or by company (a form's feed), at most 15, most first: LABEL and VALUE (a count); BY_TITLE says which. |
| `BY_TITLE` | text | required | The title of the BY chart: Filings by form (the ALL feed) or Filings by company. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the feed comes from, one object: SOURCE (SEC EDGAR submissions), RETRIEVED_AT (YYYY-MM-DD) and LICENCE. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"FEED": "8-K", "NAME": "Current reports", "FORM": "8-K", "FILINGS": 300, "COMPANIES": 222, "LATEST": "2026-10-23", "EARLIEST": "2026-10-02", "BY_TITLE": "Filings by company"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/filing-feed.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).

### filing

Pack `us-equities`, kind `filing` (SEC filing), table `filing`, key `ACCESSION`; files `data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/filing.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

One filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, ...).

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ACCESSION` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `COMPANY` | id | required | The filer: a TICKER of the us-company kind. |
| `COMPANY_NAME` | text | required | The filer's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). |
| `FORM` | text | required | The EDGAR form type as filed (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, 144, DEF 14A …). |
| `FORM_NAME` | text | required | The form type in words (8-K: Current report; 4: Change in beneficial ownership (insider)); the form type itself when the pack has no wording. |
| `FILED` | date | required | The date the filing was accepted by EDGAR (filingDate), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `REPORT_DATE` | date | optional | The period or event date the filing reports on (EDGAR reportDate), YYYY-MM-DD; absent when EDGAR gives none. |
| `PRIMARY_DOCUMENT` | text | required | The file name of the filing's primary document on EDGAR (EDGAR primaryDocument). |
| `DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION` | text | required | EDGAR's description of the primary document (primaryDocDescription). |
| `SIZE_KB` | integer | required | The filing's size on EDGAR, in kilobytes (rounded). |
| `ITEMS` | record list | required | For an 8-K, the items it reports, one element each: ITEM (8.01) and DESCRIPTION (Other events); empty for other forms. |
| `ITEMS_TEXT` | text | optional | The 8-K item numbers the filing reports, comma separated (8.01, 9.01); empty for other forms. |
| `PATH` | text | required | The filing's folder on EDGAR: <CIK without leading zeros>/<accession without dashes> (under https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/). |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"ACCESSION": "0001104659-26-117587", "COMPANY": "ABT", "COMPANY_NAME": "Abbott Laboratories", "FORM": "8-K", "FORM_NAME": "Current report", "FILED": "2026-10-21", "REPORT_DATE": "2026-10-21", "PRIMARY_DOCUMENT": "tm2627971d1_8k.htm", "DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION": "FORM 8-K", "SIZE_KB": 278, "ITEMS_TEXT": "8.01, 9.01", "PATH": "1800/000110465926117587"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/filing.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).

### financial-fact

Pack `us-equities`, kind `financial-fact` (Financial fact), table `financial-fact`, key `FACT_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/us-equities/<date>/financial-fact.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

One XBRL fact of a fiscal year.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FACT_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `COMPANY` | id | required | The company: a TICKER of the us-company kind. |
| `COMPANY_NAME` | text | required | The company's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). |
| `CIK` | text | required | The company's SEC Central Index Key, ten digits with leading zeros (text). |
| `CONCEPT` | text | required | Which financial figure the record is: REVENUE, NET_INCOME, ASSETS, LIABILITIES, EQUITY, EPS_DILUTED or SHARES_OUTSTANDING. |
| `LABEL` | text | required | The concept in words (Revenue, Net income, Total assets, Total liabilities, Stockholders' equity, Diluted EPS, Shares outstanding). |
| `UNIT` | text | required | The unit of LATEST and HISTORY[].VALUE as XBRL reports it: a currency (USD, CAD …), USD/share for EPS, or shares. |
| `XBRL_TAG` | text | required | The XBRL tags the values were read from (us-gaap or dei, comma-separated when several years used different tags; a derived value says so, "LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity less equity"). |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest fiscal year's value, the last element of HISTORY. |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | integer | required | The fiscal year of LATEST (an integer). |
| `YEARS` | integer | required | How many fiscal years HISTORY holds. |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The figure for each fiscal year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR, PERIOD_END, VALUE, FILED and ACCESSION (the annual report it came from). |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"FACT_ID": "ABT-REVENUE", "COMPANY": "ABT", "COMPANY_NAME": "Abbott Laboratories", "CIK": "0000001800", "CONCEPT": "REVENUE", "LABEL": "Revenue", "UNIT": "USD", "XBRL_TAG": "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax", "LATEST": 44328000000, "LATEST_YEAR": 2025, "YEARS": 10}
```

The contract: `config/packs/capitalmarkets/us-equities/contracts/financial-fact.contract.yaml` ([us-equities](../../docs/contracts/packs/us-equities.md)).
